main_body: Wooden flower cart: a brown cart bed (rows 10-20) with two legs/wheels below, a handle sticking out to the right, and three grey pots of flowers standing on top
top_band: none. In column x=15 the rows are a dark outline (rows 10-11), then a single lighter edge row (row 12, L=98), then the brown face (rows 13-19, L=64). Only a 1px lip separates the two, and the cart bed's top surface is hidden behind the pots.
evidence: The cart bed is drawn as a flat front-on brown slab. Only a 1px light lip (row 12) sits above it, which is the guide's 'rim only' failure. Pot bases fall straight into the dark rows 10-11, so no horizontal bed surface is visible from above. The face below row 13 is one flat tone (L=64-67), with no inset or eave shadow. The flowers and pots on top are small details and do not give the main body a top.

style.evidence: The candidate carries 33 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, and has 36 distinct colours against 40 and 38. Its flat-fill coverage is 6%, below the stall's 13%. The flowers and grey pots show several tones, and the wood has grain and plank variation. Dark edge pixels are 22% neutral, which is mixed and comparable to the well's 33%, so this is not a uniform black sticker outline. The big brown cart bed is somewhat flat, but it is not below the references on the measured facts.
